Job Position: Senior HR Manager

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time,&nbsp; On-Site

Job Summary


	We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior HR Manager to lead the company&#39;s human resources function and align HR strategies with its business objectives.
	The successful candidate will oversee HR operations, workforce planning, employee relations, talent management, performance management, and regulatory compliance while promoting a productive and engaging work environment.
	Candidates with proven HR management experience in animal feed manufacturing, agro-processing, edible oil production, food manufacturing, or related agro-allied industries are strongly preferred.
	The ideal candidate must understand the HR requirements of a production-driven business, including factory workforce management, industrial relations, shift-based operations, and employee productivity.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement HR strategies, policies, and procedures aligned with the company&#39;s business objectives.
	Advise management on workforce planning, organisational structure, succession planning, and employee-related matters.
	Review and improve HR policies, the employee handbook, and internal processes to support operational efficiency.
	Lead, coach, and develop the HR team to ensure effective service delivery across the organisation.
	Oversee recruitment, selection, onboarding, and workforce planning for managerial, technical, administrative, and production-level positions.
	Develop workforce management strategies to support factory operations, production schedules, and business growth.
	Manage employee grievances, disciplinary procedures, workplace conflicts, and other employee relations matters.
	Maintain effective communication between management and employees, promoting a positive and professional work environment.
	Manage industrial relations and address workforce issues involving factory employees, supervisors, and other operational personnel.
	Ensure compliance with applicable Nigerian labour laws, employment regulations, and statutory obligations.
	Oversee relevant statutory HR obligations, including pension contributions, PAYE, NSITF, ITF, and NHF, as applicable.
	Oversee compensation and benefits administration in collaboration with the Finance team.
	Ensure effective management of employee records, attendance, shift schedules, leave, payroll inputs, and other HR documentation.
	Monitor HR metrics, including employee turnover, absenteeism, workforce costs, and performance indicators, to support management decisions.
	Ensure the effective use of HR information systems and the maintenance of accurate and confidential employee records.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Human Resources Management, Industrial Relations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
	9 - 12 years of progressive HR experience, including at least five years in a managerial or senior HR leadership role.
	Professional certification from CIPM, CIPD, or an equivalent recognised HR body is required.
	Proven HR management experience in animal feed manufacturing, agro-processing, edible oil production, food manufacturing, or a closely related agro-allied industry is strongly preferred.
	Experience managing HR operations within a factory, production plant, or other production-driven environment.
	Demonstrable experience across multiple HR functions, including employee relations, recruitment, performance management, compensation, and HR operations.
	Proven ability to lead an HR team and manage a diverse workforce comprising management, administrative, technical, and production employees.
	Practical experience handling industrial relations, disciplinary cases, employee grievances, and workforce planning in a manufacturing environment.
	Strong knowledge of Nigerian labour laws, statutory compliance, and HR best practices.
	Experience supporting workforce productivity, organisational development, employee engagement, and talent retention.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and HR information systems; advanced Excel skills are an advantage.
	Ability to work on-site in Ibadan, Oyo State.
	Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to cv@ascentech.com.ng using (SENIOR HR MANAGER &ndash; IBADAN) as the subject of the email.


Salary
N900,000 - N1,000,000 monthly.

Method of Applicat

  "description": "Caava Group is a holding company at the forefront of transforming the African insurance landscape. We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Backend Engineer

Job Location: Lagos (Hybrid)
Reporting to: Technical Lead of the assigned Evolve team

Role Purpose


	Evolve is Caava Group&rsquo;s insurance management platform, built on Spring Boot services with Angular and Next.js frontends, and used by AIICO for its insurance operations.
	Working with experienced engineers, you will implement clearly scoped backend changes, test and debug services, and build practical knowledge of insurance workflows and dependable engineering practice.
	This entry-level role suits candidates with internship, academic or personal project experience. Technical decisions, code reviews and production changes are supported by experienced team members. Growing towards full-stack work is encouraged.


Career Path:


	Progression to Associate Software Engineer depends on consistent delivery against these measures, growing independence on larger tasks, code and test quality, and business need.


Core Accountabilities
Build and maintain Evolve services:


	Build assigned features and bug fixes in Java and Spring Boot to agreed designs, coding standards and acceptance criteria.
	Develop and update REST APIs and SQL queries. Learn the platform&rsquo;s data structures and check validation, error handling and data consistency with guidance.
	Agree API contracts with frontend engineers and keep OpenAPI documentation accurate for the endpoints you change.


Test changes and work through code review:


	Write and maintain unit and integration tests for your changes, covering normal, boundary and failure cases. Work with QA to reproduce defects and verify fixes.
	Submit small, reviewable changes through Git branches and pull requests. Explain your approach, apply feedback and keep technical documentation up to date.


Investigate issues and communicate clearly:


	Investigate issues using approved tools, logs and test environments. Record evidence and escalate unfamiliar, high-risk or production-impacting problems promptly.
	Clarify requirements with engineers, Product and QA before implementation. Estimate tasks with support, share progress and raise blockers or risks early.


Apply secure practices and support releases:


	Follow secure coding and data-handling practices. Protect credentials and customer information, and use approved test data and access permissions.
	Support release preparation and deployment checks under guidance, and learn how changes affect Evolve&rsquo;s users and insurance processes.


Additional Information:


	Works With: Backend and Frontend Engineers, QA Engineers and Product
	Scope: Assigned Evolve backend features, bug fixes, testing and release support
	Tech Stack: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, SQL and Git
	Growth Path: Associate Software Engineer, based on performance and business need


Requirements
Experience and Working Style:


	A Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical training supported by relevant projects.
	Foundational Java skills and familiarity with Spring Boot through coursework, an internship or a working project.
	Understanding of object-oriented programming, basic data structures, algorithms and debugging techniques.
	Basic knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP and JSON, relational databases and SQL, and version control with Git.
	Ability to write basic automated tests, explain your code and use documentation to solve problems.


Working Style:


	Clear written and verbal communication, attention to detail and a collaborative approach.
	Acts on feedback, follows through on assigned work and asks for help early when blocked.


Nice to Have:


	Exposure to Hibernate or JPA, or other Spring components.
	Basic frontend exposure with TypeScript, Angular or Next.js.
	Familiarity with Postman, OpenAPI documentation or CI/CD workflows, and an interest in insurance systems.

  "title": "Frontend Engineer",
  "description": "Caava Group is a holding company at the forefront of transforming the African insurance landscape. It brings together multiple complementary businesses under one umbrella &mdash; Caava Evolve, Caava AI, Agencify, and TurnQuest V4 by Caava &mdash; modernizing legacy insurer operations, expanding digital distribution through agents, and harnessing AI-driven solutions to streamline underwriting, claims, and customer engagement.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Frontend Engineer

Job Location: Lagos (Hybrid)
Reporting to: Technical Lead of the assigned Evolve team

Role Purpose


	Evolve is Caava Group&rsquo;s insurance management platform, built on Spring Boot services with Angular and Next.js frontends, and used by AIICO for its insurance operations. Working with experienced engineers, you will build clearly scoped screens and user journeys, test and debug them, and build practical knowledge of insurance workflows and dependable engineering practice.
	This entry-level role suits candidates with internship, academic or personal project experience. Technical decisions, code reviews and production changes are supported by experienced team members. Growing towards full-stack work is encouraged.


Career Path:


	Progression to Associate Software Engineer depends on consistent delivery against these measures, growing independence on larger tasks, code and test quality, and business need.


Core Accountabilities
Build and maintain Evolve screens:


	Build assigned features and bug fixes in Angular or Next.js to agreed designs, coding standards and acceptance criteria.
	Use the shared design system and components rather than rebuilding them; raise gaps with the Shared Experience squad.
	Integrate REST APIs and handle validation, loading, empty and error states. Build responsive, accessible forms and journeys with guidance.


Test changes and work through code review:


	Write and maintain unit and component tests for your changes, covering normal, boundary and failure cases. Work with QA on cross-browser checks, defect reproduction and fix verification.
	Submit small, reviewable changes through Git branches and pull requests. Explain your approach, apply feedback and keep technical documentation up to date.


Investigate issues and communicate clearly:


	Investigate issues using browser developer tools, logs and test environments. Record evidence and escalate unfamiliar, high-risk or production-impacting problems promptly.
	Clarify requirements and API contracts with backend engineers, Product and QA before implementation. Estimate tasks with support, share progress and raise blockers or risks early.


Apply secure practices and support releases:


	Follow secure frontend practices: keep credentials and customer data out of client code, logs and URLs, and use approved test data and access permissions.
	Support release preparation and deployment checks under guidance, and learn how changes affect Evolve&rsquo;s users and insurance processes.


Additional Information:


	Works With: Frontend and Backend Engineers, QA Engineers, Product and the Shared Experience squad
	Scope: Assigned Evolve screens, user journeys, bug fixes, testing and release support
	Tech Stack: TypeScript, Angular, Next.js, HTML, CSS, REST APIs and Git
	Growth Path: Associate Software Engineer, based on performance and business need


Requirements
Experience and Working Style:


	A Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical training supported by relevant projects.
	Foundational TypeScript or JavaScript, HTML and CSS skills, with a component framework (Angular, React or Next.js) used in coursework, an internship or a working project.
	Understanding of component structure, state, forms and responsive layout, plus basic debugging with browser developer tools.
	Basic knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP and JSON, and version control with Git.
	Ability to write basic automated tests, explain your code and use documentation to solve problems.


Working Style


	Attention to detail and care for how users experience a journey.
	Clear communication, a collaborative approach, and willingness to act on feedback and ask for help early.


Nice to Have:


	Exposure to both Angular and Next.js; experience in both is not expected.
	Basic accessibility knowledge such as WCAG, semantic HTML and keyboard navigation.
	Exposure to Playwright, Cypress or Jest, basic Java/Spring Boot, or an interest in insurance systems.

Job Location: Lagos (Hybrid)
Reporting to: Technical Lead of the assigned Evolve team
